component.name: Qstit
component.summary: Project and manipulate extra subtitles live

description.p: Qstit is a surtitling program: it projects subtitles line by line on a second screen during a screening or a performance, so that they can be added to a film or a play that has none in the language of the audience.

ul.li: Show the lines by hand, one key press at a time
Play them automatically, timed from an SRT file
Correct a line on the fly, and jump to any line or search the text
Choose the font, colours, outline and position of the text

description.p: Fixes a crash at start-up that kept Qstit from launching.

ul.li: The text rotation now always starts at 0 and the jump step at 0.2 seconds

description.p: Port to Qt6, full screen projection, and fixes:

ul.li: The arrow keys no longer bring back the previous line after jumping to another line
One line can take the full screen height
Fixed a crash risk when building the test card
